name: blog
title: Blog agent
description: Manages the Post Pilot blog: finds, reads, drafts, edits, publishes, unpublishes and deletes posts, sets categories, and adds attached or AI-generated images. Publishing needs a passing fact-check of the post first; published posts can only be changed by the blog owner.

name: genetics
title: Genetics agent
description: Researches genetics with public databases: ClinVar classifications of variants, gnomAD population frequencies, what genes do (NCBI Gene), PubMed literature and DNA sequence analysis. Returns findings with source links.

name: labels
title: Image Annotation Agent
description: Works in Image Label, an image annotation tool: uploads images (including ones attached in this chat), adds or cleans up annotations (polygons, circles, rectangles, pins, arrows) and exports COCO or YOLO training data. Its annotations are drafts for a person to review.

name: factcheck
title: Fact-check agent
description: Checks facts independently: splits a text (a draft post, an answer, a claim) into factual claims and verifies each against web sources it reads itself, and checks the text's links. Returns a verdict per claim (supported, partly supported, contradicted, outdated, unverified), each backed by a quote from a source. To check a blog post, give it the post id: it reads the post itself, and a passing check is recorded on the post, which the blog requires before publishing. For any other text, put the complete text in the task, word for word, links included; a summary cannot be fact-checked.

name: trials
title: Clinical Trials agent
description: Finds clinical trials in the ClinicalTrials.gov registry by condition, drug, biomarker, status, phase, age, sex and distance from a place; reads a trial's eligibility criteria, arms, outcomes and sites; summarises what is being tested for a condition; and checks claims about a trial's phase, status or results. Returns trials with registry ids and links. It never decides eligibility. Give it the condition and, when known, the place, age, sex and prior treatments.

name: drugs
title: Drug Information agent
description: Explains medicines in plain language from official FDA drug labels: what a drug is for, how it is taken, side effects, warnings, who should not take it, interactions with other medicines or alcohol, pregnancy and breastfeeding, plus FDA adverse event reports and recalls. Resolves brand and generic names. Every point quotes the label. It gives information, never personal medical advice or doses for a person. Give it the medicine's name and what the user wants to know.

name: auth
title: Auth Security agent
description: Designs and reviews sign-in and API security for apps: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect login (authorization code with PKCE), JWT access tokens and how an API validates them, sessions and cookies, roles and scopes, and OAuth for MCP servers. Produces a step-by-step plan with code for the app's stack (e.g. React, FastAPI, Express, Next.js), identity provider and infrastructure setup (e.g. Cognito, Auth0, Okta, Entra ID, API Gateway authorizers) and tests. Checks an identity provider's configuration, decodes and verifies a JWT, and checks a site's security headers and cookie flags. It can't change code or settings itself. Give it the app's stack, its identity provider if any, and what should be protected.
